overview: Understand the complete sales cycle from door knock to final payment. Manage handoffs, timelines, and communication across 9–16 weeks.
learningObjectives: Navigate each stage of the job flow
Coordinate with internal teams and insurance

sections.title: Sales Cycle Stages
sections.content: 1) Generating New Business (70 doors/day), 2) Inspection & Sign‑Up, 3) Claim Filing, 4) Adjuster Meeting, 5) Decision & Follow‑Up, 6) Project Meeting (collect ACV/downpayment; $1,000 commission), 7) Project Completion (final payment).

sections.title: Job Flow Management
sections.content: Field Portal for tasks/messages/calendar; GroupMe sign‑ups; respond within 2 weeks or reassignment; maintain consistent customer contact.
